summary: _ansible_diff (bool) tells a module to show a unified diff of changes, accessible as AnsibleModule._diff and set via the diff keyword, env var or DIFF_ALWAYS.
questions: How does my module know diff mode is enabled?
How do I turn on diff output for all tasks?

answer_card.title: _ansible_diff
answer_card.answer_md: Type `bool`. Signals the module should show a unified diff. Access as `module._diff`. Users enable it with the `diff` keyword, its env var, or `DIFF_ALWAYS`.
